BiblicalUsage: Baal-tamar was the place where Israel set the ambush against Benjamin in the last battle of the civil war, and where the men of Israel drew the Benjamites out of Gibeah to their destruction. One verse, one ambush, and the end of a tribe's rebellion.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the war at Baal-tamar is the saddest war in Scripture — brother against brother — and it shows what happens when a people will not judge evil in their own midst.
